item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the JT-60SA sign report state only what its own cohort measures; imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:1169 gates MAST's fixed blocks on _is_mast_level2_cohort (cocos_convention.py:1078) and imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:1097 supplies the cohort's own classification otherwise, and the regenerated report at docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-sign-cohort.html prints "COHORT COEFFICIENT CLASSIFICATION" with sigma_Bp and sigma_rho_theta_phi measured and e_Bp/sigma_R_phi_Z left to an external declaration, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the three gate results, names its logs under test_logs (gate-cocos.log, gate-ruff.log, gate-cohort-script.log), records a negative control (negative-control.log, EXIT=1, 1 failed 27 passed), and states the run executed in place on the fleet allocation; it names no baseline_suite and no after_suite, so no two-arm suite delta is derivable from the reviewed run's own logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths and diffed a8c1d7a3..8c4d6e4a; the commit touches imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py, tests/data/test_cocos_convention.py, scripts/jt60sa_sign_cohort.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-sign-cohort.html and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-sign-cohort-repair.html alone, every one inside the node fence, with no figure file touched.

justifications.durability: tests/data/test_cocos_convention.py:840 and :884 fail if format_sign_report reverts to printing MAST's blocks for a foreign cohort, and :812 fails if a no-psi row regains a hard-coded exponent; the negative control at negative-control.log mutates read_signal_map_observation and reddens test_negating_the_equilibrium_field_makes_the_q_relation_report_a_violation (1 failed, 27 passed, EXIT=1), so the guarded reader is shown to fire.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the node's own done-when and its gate-cocos.log names 28 passed at revision a8c1d7a3, a count only the head test file reaches (the base had 21), and it reproduced here; but the log's own revision line names the base a8c1d7a3 rather than the measured head, so the header does not tie the recorded count to the commit it ran on.
justifications.fit: the added helpers are mechanism-named (cocos_convention.py:1078, cocos_convention.py:1090, cocos_convention.py:1097) in the module's existing underscore style, extend the CoefficientAssessment shape at cocos_convention.py:82, and the whole-tree ruff check exits 0 with no naming finding.
justifications.goal_fidelity: cocos_convention.py:1169 makes mast_cohort decide every MAST-only block, and the 16-row JT-60SA report at jtmm-sign-cohort.html now carries COHORT COEFFICIENT CLASSIFICATION with sigma_Bp and sigma_rho_theta_phi measured and e_Bp/sigma_R_phi_Z undetermined, which is exactly what the goal asks.
justifications.reuse: _cohort_coefficient_classification reuses the CoefficientAssessment owner at cocos_convention.py:82 rather than forking it, _common_sign has no prior owner in cocos_convention.py, and the searched capability (a cohort-specific coefficient classification) exists only as the MAST-only COEFFICIENT_ASSESSMENTS constant, which the new function leaves intact.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff a8c1d7a3..8c4d6e4a changes five paths and every one is inside the manifest's declared write_paths, with no figure file touched and nothing outside the node's fence.
